 Goa vs Mumbai SMAT Live Streaming Info: Watch Suryakumar Yadav, Sarfaraz Khan in Action
 Vishal Bhawani Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 06:40 AM 3 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Suryakumar Yadav Mumbai will face Goa in an Elite Group D clash of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2026-27 on Wednesday, November 18. The match will take place at Jadavpur University Campus 2nd Ground in Kolkata. The first ball of the GOA vs MUM SMAT match is scheduled for 12:30 PM IST.
 Mumbai enter this fixture after winning both their opening matches. They currently lead Elite Group D with four points on the back of their dangerous batting line-up which consists of players like Suryakumar Yadav and Sarfaraz Khan. Goa, meanwhile, are searching for their first victory after consecutive defeats and face a tough task against a Mumbai team, which has some of the best batsmen in India .
 There is no doubt that Mumbai have one of the largest fanbases amongst all the domestic teams due to the high quality of cricket. If you want to experience it, you can find the Goa vs Mumbai SMAT live stream and match details here.
 Where to Watch Goa vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 Match Live?
 The Goa vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 live streaming is unavailable and this match won't be broadcast live. Although selected tournament matches are being broadcast on Star Sports Network and JioHotstar, this particular fixture is not scheduled for live coverage.
 However, fans can follow toss updates, live scores and ball-by-ball commentary for the Goa vs Mumbai Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live streaming through the Sportsdunia Live Cricket Score . It will provide you the fastest updates related to this big game.
 Advertisement
 Suryakumar Yadav and Sarfaraz Khan in Focus Against Goa
 Mumbai captain Suryakumar Yadav has been in outstanding form during the ongoing SMAT campaign. He has scored 142 runs across two innings at an impressive strike rate of 284.00.
 Suryakumar started with an unbeaten 60 off 21 balls against Hyderabad and followed it with an explosive 82 off 29 deliveries against Gujarat. Sarfaraz Khan also contributed with an unbeaten 40 off 17 balls in Mumbai's successful chase against Gujarat.
 Mumbai also have batters like Shivam Dube , Musheer Khan and Shardul Thakur in their lineup. Their batting depth makes them a strong challenge for Goa. Meanwhile, Goa will rely on captain Abhinav Tejrana, who scored 76 off 36 balls against Uttarakhand.
 Deepraj Gaonkar and Suyash Prabhudessai are also important batting options. The bowling attack will need to contain Mumbai's aggressive batters. Mumbai have won both their matches while chasing at this venue. Goa will need a stronger all-round performance to challenge the undefeated side.
